{
  "dataset_name": "first_order_theorem_proving",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "gemini-3.1-pro-preview",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "v1_v2_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of V1 to the absolute value of V2 (plus a constant to avoid division by zero), capturing the relative magnitude of these two primary features.",
      "value_range": [-2.0, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a normalized ratio of two primary heuristic features, allowing the linear SVM to capture their relative magnitude without instability near zero.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V1 / (np.abs(V2) + 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "v12_v28_max",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "The maximum value between V12 and V28, which are both features with potentially large positive outliers.",
      "value_range": [-1.0, 45.0],
      "feature_family": "extreme_value",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures the extreme values of two high-variance features, providing a strong margin signal for cases where either heuristic spikes.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.maximum(V12, V28)"
    },
    {
      "name": "v9_v13_v15_composite",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "A simple linear sum of V9, V13, and V15, aggregating features that share similar high-magnitude distributions.",
      "value_range": [-2.0, 40.0],
      "feature_family": "composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Creates a linear composite of related high-magnitude features, reducing dimensionality and providing a smoother signal for the SVM margin.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V9 + V13 + V15"
    },
    {
      "name": "v45_v51_min",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "The minimum value between V45 and V51, capturing the lower bound of two features with negative skew.",
      "value_range": [-3.0, 1.5],
      "feature_family": "extreme_value",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures the lower bound of two negatively skewed features, useful for defining a decision boundary based on minimum threshold conditions.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.minimum(V45, V51)"
    },
    {
      "name": "v1_to_v5_l2_approx",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Approximate L2 norm of the first five features, representing their combined magnitude in a Euclidean space.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "magnitude",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a continuous severity measure of the first five features' combined magnitude, transforming a spherical region into a linear feature for the SVM.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt(np.maximum(0, V1**2 + V2**2 + V3**2 + V4**2 + V5**2))"
    },
    {
      "name": "v12_log_transform",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Logarithmic transformation of V12 to compress its long positive tail.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "transformation",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Compresses the long tail of V12, preventing extreme outliers from dominating the linear SVM weights and improving margin stability.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(np.maximum(V12, 0))"
    },
    {
      "name": "v28_v29_diff",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "The linear difference between V28 and V29, measuring their divergence.",
      "value_range": [-30.0, 30.0],
      "feature_family": "difference",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Explicitly provides the linear difference between two highly variable features, allowing the SVM to directly weight their divergence.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V28 - V29"
    },
    {
      "name": "v33_v43_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Multiplicative interaction between V33 and V43, which both have relatively low variance.",
      "value_range": [-1.0, 15.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Introduces a multiplicative interaction between two low-variance features, enabling the linear model to capture their combined effect.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V33 * V43"
    },
    {
      "name": "high_value_count_approx",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Counts the number of features among a selected subset (V9, V12, V13, V15, V21, V22, V28, V29) that exceed a threshold of 5.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 8.0],
      "feature_family": "count",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a discrete count of extreme heuristic values, acting as a step-function severity measure that can strongly influence the SVM decision boundary.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(V9>5,1,0) + np.where(V12>5,1,0) + np.where(V13>5,1,0) + np.where(V15>5,1,0) + np.where(V21>5,1,0) + np.where(V22>5,1,0) + np.where(V28>5,1,0) + np.where(V29>5,1,0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "v1_v2_v3_v4_v5_mean",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "The arithmetic mean of the first five features.",
      "value_range": [-2.0, 2.0],
      "feature_family": "composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Averages the first five features to create a low-variance, smooth composite score, ideal for stable linear SVM weight assignment.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(V1 + V2 + V3 + V4 + V5) / 5.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "heuristic_complexity_judgment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of the overall complexity of the theorem proving state, based on the magnitude and distribution of search-related variables.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_assessment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a holistic, continuous severity measure of complexity that may not be easily captured by simple linear combinations, aiding in margin separation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "proof_search_stability_judgment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of the stability of the proof search, evaluating the variance and presence of extreme values across the heuristic features.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_assessment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Offers a normalized score representing search stability, allowing the linear SVM to adjust its confidence or decision boundary based on state volatility.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
